This '''national electoral calendar for 2016''' lists the national/[[Federation|federal]] elections held in 2016 in all [[List of sovereign states|sovereign states]] and their [[Dependent territory|dependent territories]]. [[By-election]]s are excluded, though national [[referendum]]s are included.{{Elections}}

==January==
*7 January: [[Elections in Kiribati|Kiribati]], [[Kiribati parliamentary election, 2015–16|Parliament (2nd round)]]<ref>{{cite news |title=Voter registration closes in Kiribati |url=http://www.radionz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/292403/voter-registration-closes-in-kiribati |work=[[Radio New Zealand International]] |date=17 December 2015 |access-date=27 December 2015}}</ref>
*16 January: [[Elections in Taiwan|Taiwan]], [[2016 Taiwanese presidential election|President]] and [[2016 Taiwanese legislative election|Parliament]]<ref>{{cite news |title=Presidential, legislative elections set for Jan. 16, 2016 |url=http://focustaiwan.tw/news/aipl/201503170010.aspx |work=[[Focus Taiwan]] |date=17 March 2015 |access-date=19 March 2015}}</ref>
*22 January: [[Elections in Vanuatu|Vanuatu]], [[2016 Vanuatuan general election|Parliament]]<ref>{{cite news |title=Vanuatu snap election after MPs jailed |url=https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-35379037 |publisher=[[BBC News]] |date=22 January 2016 |access-date=22 January 2016}}</ref>
*24 January: [[Elections in Portugal|Portugal]], [[2016 Portuguese presidential election|President]]<ref>{{cite news |title=Portugal goes to the polls in key presidential vote |url=https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-35394532 |publisher=[[BBC News]] |date=24 January 2016 |access-date=24 January 2016}}</ref>

==February==
*14 February: [[Elections in the Central African Republic|Central African Republic]], [[2015–16 Central African general election|President {{Nowrap|(2nd round)}} and Parliament {{Nowrap|(1st round)}}]]<ref>{{cite news |author=Krista Larson |title=Central African Republic to go ahead with elections Sunday |url=http://www.metronews.ca/news/world/2016/02/10/central-african-republic-to-go-ahead-with-elections-sunday.html |work=[[Metro News|Metro News Canada]] |location=[[Bangui]] |agency=[[Associated Press]] |date=9 February 2016 |access-date=11 February 2016 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160215230741/http://www.metronews.ca/news/world/2016/02/10/central-african-republic-to-go-ahead-with-elections-sunday.html |archive-date=15 February 2016 |url-status=dead }}</ref>
*18 February: [[Elections in Uganda|Uganda]], [[2016 Ugandan general election|President and Parliament]]<ref>{{cite news |title=Uganda election: Issues, candidates and the poll |url=https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-35522675 |publisher=[[BBC News]] |date=10 February 2016 |access-date=11 February 2016}}</ref>
*21 February: 
**[[Elections in Bolivia|Bolivia]], [[2016 Bolivian constitutional referendum|Constitutional Referendum]]
**[[Elections in the Comoros|Comoros]], [[2016 Comorian presidential election|President (1st round)]]
**[[Elections in Niger|Niger]], [[2016 Nigerien general election|President (1st round) and Parliament]]<ref name="Niger">{{cite news |title=Niger to hold presidential election on February 21 |url=http://www.nation.co.ke/news/africa/Niger-to-hold-presidential-election-on-February-21/-/1066/2813852/-/format/xhtml/view/printVersion/-/qgao05/-/index.html |newspaper=[[Daily Nation]] |location=[[Nairobi]] |date=30 July 2015 |access-date=27 September 2015 |archive-date=28 September 2015 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150928084002/http://www.nation.co.ke/news/africa/Niger-to-hold-presidential-election-on-February-21/-/1066/2813852/-/format/xhtml/view/printVersion/-/qgao05/-/index.html |url-status=dead }}</ref>
*25 February: [[Elections in Jamaica|Jamaica]], [[2016 Jamaican general election|House of Representatives]]<ref>{{cite news |title=#JaVotes2016: 152 candidates nominated for general election |url=http://jamaica-gleaner.com/article/news/20160209/javotes2016-152-candidates-nominated-general-election |newspaper=[[The Gleaner]] |location=[[Kingston, Jamaica|Kingston]] |date=9 February 2016 |access-date=13 February 2016 }}</ref>
*26 February: 
**[[Elections in Iran|Iran]], [[2016 Iranian legislative election|Parliament (1st round)]] and [[2016 Iranian Assembly of Experts election|Assembly of Experts]]
**[[Elections in the Republic of Ireland|Ireland]], [[2016 Irish general election|Assembly]]
*28 February: [[Elections in Switzerland|Switzerland]], [[2016 Swiss referendums#February referendums|Referendums]]

==March==
*3–24 March: [[Elections in New Zealand|New Zealand]], [[2015–2016 New Zealand flag referendums|Referendum (2nd round)]]<ref>{{cite web | url=http://www.electionresults.govt.nz/2016_flag_referendum2/ | title=Second Referendum on the New Zealand Flag – Preliminary Result | date=24 March 2016 | publisher=New Zealand Electoral Commission | access-date=28 March 2016 | url-status=dead | archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160325203541/http://www.electionresults.govt.nz/2016_flag_referendum2/ | archive-date=25 March 2016 }}</ref>
*4 March: [[Elections in Samoa|Samoa]], [[2016 Samoan general election|Parliament]]
*5 March: [[Elections in Slovakia|Slovakia]], [[2016 Slovak parliamentary election|Parliament]]<ref>{{cite news |date=2015-11-12 |title=Prieskum: Voľby do Národnej rady sa budú konať 5. marca 2016 |url=http://spravy.pravda.sk/domace/clanok/373630-volby-den-d-ma-byt-5-marec/ |language=sk |newspaper=[[Pravda (Slovakia)]] |access-date=2015-11-12}}</ref>
*6 March: [[Elections in Benin|Benin]], [[2016 Beninese presidential election|President (1st round)]]<ref>{{cite news |title=Benin elections: 33 candidates fight for presidency |url=https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-35739042 |publisher=[[BBC News]] |date=6 March 2016 |access-date=6 March 2016}}</ref>
*9 March: [[Elections in Kiribati|Kiribati]], [[2016 Kiribati presidential election|President]]<ref>{{cite web |title=Kiribati chooses a new president today |url=http://www.radionz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/298462/kiribati-chooses-a-new-president-today |work=[[RNZ International]] |date=9 March 2016 |access-date=9 March 2016}}</ref>
*20 March: 
**[[Elections in Benin|Benin]], [[2016 Beninese presidential election|President (2nd round)]]<ref>{{cite news |title=Benin PM Lionel Zinsou to face Patrice Talon in run-off vote |url=https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-35753438 |publisher=[[BBC News]] |date=8 March 2016 |access-date=9 March 2016}}</ref>
**[[Elections in Cape Verde|Cape Verde]], [[2016 Cape Verdean parliamentary election|Parliament]]<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.dgape.cv/index.php/noticias/9-ultimas-noticias/98-eleicoes-legislativas-sera-a-20-de-marco-de-2016|title=Legislative Elections will be on March 20, 2016|publisher=Direcção Geral de Apoio ao Processo Eleitoral|date=10 December 2015|access-date=19 January 2016|archive-date=1 February 2016|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160201092854/http://www.dgape.cv/index.php/noticias/9-ultimas-noticias/98-eleicoes-legislativas-sera-a-20-de-marco-de-2016|url-status=dead}} {{in lang|pt}}</ref><ref name="SuperSunday">{{cite news |title=Voters in Benin, Cape Verde, Congo, Niger, Senegal and Zanzibar go to polls |url=https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-35854768 |publisher=[[BBC News]] |date=21 March 2016 |access-date=21 March 2016}}</ref>
**[[Elections in Kazakhstan|Kazakhstan]], [[2016 Kazakhstani legislative election|Assembly]]<ref>{{cite news |title=Nazarbaev Dissolves Kazakh Parliament, Sets Date For Early Elections |url=https://www.rferl.org/a/kazakhstan-parliament-dissolved-new-elections/27499464.html |publisher=[[Radio Free Europe/Radio Liberty]] |date=20 January 2016 |access-date=21 January 2016}}</ref>
**[[Elections in Laos|Laos]], [[2016 Laotian parliamentary election|Parliament]]
**[[Elections in Niger|Niger]], [[2016 Nigerien general election|President (2nd round)]]<ref name="Niger"/><ref name="SuperSunday"/>
**[[Elections in the Republic of the Congo|Republic of Congo]], [[2016 Republic of the Congo presidential election|President]]<ref name="SuperSunday"/>
**[[Elections in Senegal|Senegal]], [[2016 Senegalese constitutional referendum|Constitutional Referendum]]<ref>{{cite news |title=Senegal President Macky Sall seeks shorter terms |url=https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-35345065 |publisher=[[BBC News]] |date=18 January 2016 |access-date=19 January 2016}}</ref>
*31 March: [[Elections in the Central African Republic|Central African Republic]], [[2015–16 Central African general election|Parliament (2nd round)]]<ref>{{cite news |language=fr |title=Centrafrique : le second tour des législatives reporté au lendemain de l'investiture du nouveau président |url=http://adiac-congo.com/content/centrafrique-le-second-tour-des-legislatives-reporte-au-lendemain-de-linvestiture-du-nouveau |work=ADIAC |date=25 March 2016 |access-date=25 March 2016}}</ref>

==April==
*6 April: [[Elections in the Netherlands|Netherlands]], [[2016 Dutch Ukraine–European Union Association Agreement referendum|Referendum]]
*8 April: [[Elections in Djibouti|Djibouti]], [[2016 Djiboutian presidential election|President]]<ref>{{cite news |title=Djibouti election: What you need to know |url=https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-35971744 |publisher=[[BBC News]] |date=7 April 2016 |access-date=8 April 2016}}</ref>
*10 April: 
**[[Elections in Chad|Chad]], [[2016 Chadian presidential election|President]]<ref>{{cite news |title=Chad President Idriss Deby seeks fifth term in office |url=https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-35541642 |publisher=BBC News |date=10 February 2016 |access-date=11 February 2016}}</ref>
**[[Elections in the Comoros|Comoros]], [[2016 Comorian presidential election|President (2nd round)]]
**[[Elections in Peru|Peru]], [[2016 Peruvian general election|President (1st round) and Parliament]]
*13 April: 
**[[Elections in South Korea|South Korea]], [[2016 South Korean legislative election|Parliament]]
**[[Elections in Syria|Syria]], [[2016 Syrian parliamentary election|Parliament]]
*17 April: [[Elections in Italy|Italy]], [[2016 Italian oil drilling referendum|Referendum]]<ref>{{cite web|title=Referendum sulle trivellazioni marine|url=http://www.lexitalia.it/a/2016/72321|website=LexItalia.it|access-date=17 February 2016|date=16 February 2016}}</ref>
*24 April: 
**[[Elections in Austria|Austria]], [[2016 Austrian presidential election|President (1st round)]]
**[[Elections in Equatorial Guinea|Equatorial Guinea]], [[2016 Equatorial Guinean presidential election|President]]<ref>{{cite news|url=http://www.jeuneafrique.com/depeches/309546/politique/guinee-equatoriale-presidentielle-fixee-24-avril/|language=fr|title=Guinée équatoriale: la présidentielle fixée au 24 avril|work=[[Jeune Afrique]]|date=12 March 2016}}</ref>
**[[Elections in Serbia|Serbia]], [[2016 Serbian parliamentary election|Parliament]]<ref>{{cite news |title=Serbia Government Asks President To Call Early Elections |url=https://www.rferl.org/a/serbia-government-asks-president-for-early-elections/27587815.html |publisher=[[Radio Free Europe/Radio Liberty]] |date=4 March 2016 |access-date=4 March 2016}}</ref>
*27 April: ''[[Elections in Guernsey|Guernsey]], [[2016 Guernsey general election|Legislature]]''<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.election2016.gg/ |title=GUERNSEY STATES ELECTION 2016 |publisher=Guernsey Government |access-date=22 November 2015 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20151230061957/http://www.election2016.gg/ |archive-date=30 December 2015 |url-status=dead }}</ref>
*29 April: [[Elections in Iran|Iran]], [[2016 Iranian legislative election|Parliament (2nd round)]]

==May==
*9 May: [[Elections in the Philippines|Philippines]], [[2016 Philippine presidential election|President, Vice President]], [[2016 Philippine House of Representatives elections|House of Representatives]] and [[2016 Philippine Senate election|Senate]]
*11 May: [[Elections in the Comoros|Comoros]], [[2016 Comorian presidential election|President (2nd round in 13 constituencies)]] on [[Anjouan]])<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.africanews.com/2016/05/10/key-presidential-re-run-in-comoros-on-may-11|title=Key presidential re-run in Comoros on May 11|work=[[Africanews]]|date=10 May 2016}}</ref>
*14 May: [[Elections in the Philippines|Philippines]], [[2016 Philippine presidential election|President, Vice President]], [[2016 Philippine House of Representatives elections|House of Representatives]] and [[2016 Philippine Senate election|Senate (in 55 precincts)]]<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.philstar.com/headlines/2016/05/14/1583148/comelec-holds-special-polls|title=Comelec holds special polls|work=[[The Philippine Star]]|date=14 May 2016}}</ref>
*15 May: [[Elections in the Dominican Republic|Dominican Republic]], [[2016 Dominican Republic general election|President, Chamber of Deputies and Senate]]
*22 May: 
**[[Elections in Austria|Austria]], [[2016 Austrian presidential election|<s>President (2nd round)</s>]] (round nullified)<ref name=over>{{cite news|last1=Oltermann|first1=Philip|title=Austrian presidential election result overturned and must be held again|url=https://www.theguardian.com/world/2016/jul/01/austrian-presidential-election-result-overturned-and-must-be-held-again-hofer-van-der-bellen|access-date=1 July 2016|work=[[The Guardian]]|date=1 July 2016}}</ref>
**[[Elections in Cyprus|Cyprus]], [[2016 Cypriot legislative election|Parliament]]
**[[Elections in Tajikistan|Tajikistan]], [[2016 Tajikistani constitutional referendum|Constitutional Referendum]]<ref>{{cite news |title=Date Set For Tajik Referendum on Constitutional Changes |url=https://www.rferl.org/a/tajikistan-date-set-for-constitutional-referendum/27542733.html |publisher=[[Radio Free Europe/Radio Liberty]] |date=10 February 2016 |access-date=10 February 2016}}</ref>
**[[Elections in Vietnam|Vietnam]], [[2016 Vietnamese legislative election|Parliament]]

==June==
*5 June: 
**[[Elections in Peru|Peru]], [[2016 Peruvian general election|President (2nd round)]]<ref>{{cite news |title=Five things you need to know about Peru's election |url=https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-36443254 |publisher=[[BBC News]] |date=4 June 2016 |access-date=4 June 2016}}</ref>
**[[Elections in Switzerland|Switzerland]], [[2016 Swiss referendums#June referendums|Referendums]]
*6 June: [[Elections in Saint Lucia|Saint Lucia]], [[2016 Saint Lucian general election|House of Assembly]]<ref>{{cite news |title=PM Announces Election Date |url=http://stluciatimes.com/2016/05/19/announces-election-date |work=St. Lucia Times |date=19 May 2016 |access-date=27 May 2016 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160821045630/http://stluciatimes.com/2016/05/19/announces-election-date |archive-date=21 August 2016 |url-status=dead }}</ref>
*7 June: [[Elections in the Bahamas|Bahamas]], [[2016 Bahamian constitutional referendum|Constitutional Referendum]]
*23 June: 
**''[[Elections in Bermuda|Bermuda]], [[2016 Bermudian same-sex union and marriage referendum|Referendum]]''
**''[[Elections in Gibraltar|Gibraltar]], [[European Union (Referendum) Act 2016 (Gibraltar)|Brexit Referendum]]''
**[[Elections in the United Kingdom|United Kingdom]], [[2016 United Kingdom European Union membership referendum|Brexit Referendum]]
*25 June: [[Elections in Iceland|Iceland]], [[2016 Icelandic presidential election|President]]
*26 June: [[Elections in Spain|Spain]], [[2016 Spanish general election|Congress of Deputies]]<ref>{{cite news|title=The King will oversee another round of talks on 25–26 April |language=es |url=http://politica.elpais.com/politica/2016/04/12/actualidad/1460450849_302458.html |newspaper=[[El País]] |date=2016-04-12}}</ref>
*29 June: [[Elections in Mongolia|Mongolia]], [[2016 Mongolian legislative election|Parliament]]<ref>{{cite web|url=http://mongolianembassy.us/about-mongolia/government-and-politics/#.VmVw99KLSM8|title=Government and politics|date=21 May 2013 |publisher=Embassy of Mongolia to the United States of America|access-date=13 August 2020}}</ref>

==July==
*2 July: [[Elections in Australia|Australia]], [[2016 Australian federal election|House of Representatives and Senate]]<ref>{{cite news |title=Poll date for Australia election officially confirmed |url=https://www.bbc.com/news/world-australia-36240528 |publisher=[[BBC News]] |date=8 May 2016 |access-date=8 May 2016}}</ref>
*9 July: [[Elections in Nauru|Nauru]], [[2016 Nauruan parliamentary election|Parliament]]<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.naurugov.nr/government-information-office/media-release/speaker-appoints-9-july-for-general-elections.aspx|title=Speaker appoints 9 July for general elections|publisher=Government of Nauru|access-date=26 July 2016|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160624024217/http://www.naurugov.nr/government-information-office/media-release/speaker-appoints-9-july-for-general-elections.aspx|archive-date=24 June 2016|url-status=dead}}</ref>
*10 July: 
**''[[Elections in Abkhazia|Abkhazia]], [[2016 Abkhazian early presidential elections referendum|Referendum]]''<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.rferl.org/a/caucasus-report-abkhazia-early-presidential/27788330.html|title=Abkhaz Leader Agrees To Opposition's Demand For Referendum|publisher=[[Radio Free Europe/Radio Liberty]]|date=9 June 2016}}</ref>
**[[Elections in Japan|Japan]], [[2016 Japanese House of Councillors election|House of Councillors]]
*11 July: [[Elections in Nauru|Nauru]], [[2016 Nauruan parliamentary election|Parliament]] [[Aiwo Constituency|(Aiwo only)]]<ref>{{cite web|url=https://thecommonwealth.org/media/news/commonwealth-observer-mission-congratulate-nauru-general-election|title=Commonwealth Observer Mission congratulate Nauru for participating peacefully in their General Election|publisher=[[Commonwealth Secretariat]]|date=11 July 2016}}</ref>
*17 July: [[Elections in São Tomé and Príncipe|São Tomé and Príncipe]], [[2016 São Tomé and Príncipe presidential election|President (1st round)]]<ref name="São-Tomé-and-Príncipe">{{cite news|title=São Tomé presidential election results canceled for a second round|url=http://www.africanews.com/2016/07/22/sao-tome-presidential-election-results-canceled-for-a-second-round/|access-date=23 July 2016|work=[[Africanews]]|date=22 July 2016}}</ref>

==August==
*7 August: 
**[[Elections in São Tomé and Príncipe|São Tomé and Príncipe]], [[2016 São Tomé and Príncipe presidential election|President (2nd round)]]<ref name="São-Tomé-and-Príncipe"/>
**[[Elections in Thailand|Thailand]], [[2016 Thai constitutional referendum|Constitutional Referendum]]<ref name="Nation1">{{cite news|last1=Chanwanpen|first1=Kasamakorn|title=Scandals may hurt referendum|url=http://www.nationmultimedia.com/politics/Scandals-may-hurt-referendum-30284612.html|access-date=25 April 2016|work=[[The Nation (Thailand)]]|date=25 April 2016|archive-date=26 April 2016|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160426172409/http://www.nationmultimedia.com/politics/Scandals-may-hurt-referendum-30284612.html|url-status=dead}}</ref>
*11 August: [[Elections in Zambia|Zambia]], [[2016 Zambian general election|President, Parliament]] and [[2016 Zambian constitutional referendum|Constitutional Referendum]]<ref>{{cite news |title=What is at stake in Zambia's elections? |url=https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-37008989 |publisher=[[BBC News]] |date=9 August 2016 |access-date=11 August 2016}}</ref>
*21 August: [[Elections in Turkmenistan|Turkmenistan]], [[2016 Turkmen Council of Elders election|Council of Elders]]<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.azernews.az/region/101143.html|title=Turkmenistan holds elections to parliament, local authorities|website=AzerNews|date=21 August 2016}}</ref>
*27 August: [[Elections in Gabon|Gabon]], [[2016 Gabonese presidential election|President]]

==September==
*4 September: ''[[Elections in Hong Kong|Hong Kong]], [[2016 Hong Kong legislative election|Legislature]]''
*8–10 September: [[Elections in Seychelles|Seychelles]], [[2016 Seychellois parliamentary election|Parliament]]
*11 September: 
**[[Elections in Belarus|Belarus]], [[2016 Belarusian parliamentary election|House of Representatives]]<ref>{{cite web |last1=Najibullah |first1=Farangis |author2=RFE/RL's Belarusian Service |title=Belarus Vote Likely To Keep Lukashenka Allies in Firm Control |url=https://www.rferl.org/a/belarus-lukashenko-lukashenka-elections/27979453.html |publisher=[[Radio Free Europe/Radio Liberty]] |date=11 September 2016 |access-date=11 September 2016}}</ref>
**[[Elections in Croatia|Croatia]], [[2016 Croatian parliamentary election|Parliament]]<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.politico.eu/article/kolinda-grabar-kitarovic-croatian-president-calls-snap-election-no-confidence-vote/|title=Croatian president calls snap election|date=16 July 2016|work=[[Politico Europe]]|access-date=26 July 2016}}</ref>
*18 September: 
**[[Elections in Liechtenstein|Liechtenstein]], [[2016 Liechtenstein Family Allowances Act referendum|Referendum]]
**[[Elections in Russia|Russia]], [[2016 Russian legislative election|State Duma]]<ref>{{cite web |title=Duma Approves Early Parliamentary Vote In 2016 |url=https://www.rferl.org/a/russia-early-parliamentary-vote-2016/27081887.html |publisher=[[Radio Free Europe/Radio Liberty]] |date=19 June 2015 |access-date=8 October 2015}}</ref>
*20 September: [[Elections in Jordan|Jordan]], [[2016 Jordanian general election|House of Representatives]]
*22 September: ''[[Elections in the Isle of Man|Isle of Man]], [[2016 Manx general election|House of Keys]]''
*25 September: [[Elections in Switzerland|Switzerland]], [[2016 Swiss referendums#September referendums|Referendums]]
*26 September:
**[[Elections in Azerbaijan|Azerbaijan]], [[2016 Azerbaijani constitutional referendum|Constitutional Referendum]]<ref>{{cite web |title=President of Azerbaijan specifies date of referendum |url=http://news.az/articles/official/110764 |website=News.Az |date=26 July 2016 |access-date=27 July 2016}}</ref>
**''[[Elections in Sint Maarten|Sint Maarten]], [[2016 Sint Maarten general election|Legislature]]''

==October==
*2 October: 
**[[Elections in Cape Verde|Cape Verde]], [[2016 Cape Verdean presidential election|President]]
**[[Elections in Colombia|Colombia]], [[2016 Colombian peace agreement referendum|Referendum]]<ref>{{cite news |title=Colombia and Farc rebels reach historic peace agreement |url=https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-37180752 |publisher=[[BBC News]] |date=24 August 2016 |access-date=24 August 2016}}</ref>
**[[Elections in Hungary|Hungary]], [[2016 Hungarian migrant quota referendum|Referendum]]
*5 October: ''[[Elections in Curaçao|Curaçao]], [[2016 Curaçao general election|Legislature]]''
*7 October: [[Elections in Morocco|Morocco]], [[2016 Moroccan general election|House of Representatives]]<ref>{{cite news |author=Aziz El Yaakoubi |title=Morocco to hold parliamentary elections on Oct. 7 – government |url=https://www.reuters.com/article/morocco-election-idUSL8N15C4WF |work=[[Reuters]] |date=28 January 2016 |access-date=17 February 2016}}</ref>
*7–8 October: [[Elections in the Czech Republic|Czech Republic]], [[2016 Czech Senate election|Senate (1st round)]]
*8 October: [[Elections in Georgia (country)|Georgia]], [[2016 Georgian parliamentary election|Parliament (1st round)]]<ref>{{cite web |title=Georgian President Sets October 8 Date For Parliamentary Elections |url=https://www.rferl.org/a/georgian-president-margvelashvili-sets-october-8-date-parliamentary-elections/27778873.html |publisher=[[Radio Free Europe/Radio Liberty]] |date=4 June 2016 |access-date=4 June 2016}}</ref>
*9 October: [[Elections in Lithuania|Lithuania]], [[2016 Lithuanian parliamentary election|Parliament (1st round)]]
*14–15 October: [[Elections in the Czech Republic|Czech Republic]], [[2016 Czech Senate election|Senate (2nd round)]]
*16 October: [[Elections in Montenegro|Montenegro]], [[2016 Montenegrin parliamentary election|Parliament]]
*23 October: [[Elections in Lithuania|Lithuania]], [[2016 Lithuanian parliamentary election|Parliament (2nd round)]]
*29 October: [[Elections in Iceland|Iceland]], [[2016 Icelandic parliamentary election|Parliament]]
*30 October: 
**[[Elections in Georgia (country)|Georgia]], [[2016 Georgian parliamentary election|Parliament (2nd round)]]
**[[Elections in Ivory Coast|Ivory Coast]], [[2016 Ivorian constitutional referendum|Constitutional Referendum]]<ref>{{cite news |author1=Ange Aboa |author2=Joe Bavier |title=Ivory Coast parliament votes to hold referendum on new constitution |url=https://www.reuters.com/article/us-ivorycoast-politics-idUSKCN1022CA |work=[[Reuters]] |date=22 July 2016 |access-date=7 August 2016}}</ref>
**[[Elections in Moldova|Moldova]], [[2016 Moldovan presidential election|President (1st round)]]<ref>{{cite web |title=Moldova Switches To Direct Presidential Elections |url=https://www.rferl.org/a/moldova-sitches-to-direct-presidential-elections/27589691.html |publisher=[[Radio Free Europe/Radio Liberty]] |date=4 March 2016 |access-date=5 March 2016}}</ref>

==November==
*1 November: [[Elections in Palau|Palau]], [[2016 Palauan presidential election|President]], [[2016 Palauan general election|House of Delegates]] and [[2016 Palauan general election|Senate]]
